author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam Savage answers live-stream questions about the workshop tools you don't need to spend a fortune on! From affordable Forstner bits and step drills to Japanese pull saws and an unexpectedly awesome $45 chamfering tool, Adam shares when cheap tools do the job as well as expensive ones. Plus, updates on desktop CNC options and budget-friendly prototyping materials for casting and carving. What cheap tools do YOU recommend?

With thanks to Tested members Threebeerd and FrodoWills for their questions and support! Join this channel to support Tested and get access to perks, like asking Adam a question:
